rules.text: Pressing Z advances dialogue text and confirms menus. Enter also confirms.
Dialogue and story text advance only when a confirm key is pressed; waiting forever does nothing.
Up/Down/Left/Right move the selection cursor in menus.

Never press Esc in this game. The Esc key is not used here: it does not advance dialogue, does not open the menu and must never appear in the action output. Confirm with Z, go back with Backspace, open the menu with C.

The only keys that exist in this game are the ones listed under Common Keys. Never emit Esc, Tab, Caps, Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Delete, Insert, Home, End, Pause, F1-F12, number keys or mouse buttons; if no key is needed, an empty group is correct.

The UNDERTALE title screen shows a large UNDERTALE logo and the line [PRESS Z OR ENTER]. Nothing moves on that screen: walking keys and the mouse do nothing there. Press Z (confirm) once to start the game; only after the intro, when the character stands in a room, do walking keys work.

Movement uses the arrow keys only: Up / Down / Left / Right. The letters W, A, S, D do nothing at all here - pressing W does not walk and does not move the character. To walk up, emit the group Up; to walk down emit Down.
